actions.name: Dual Strike
actions.description: When making a full attack with two different weapons mounted on your arms, you attack twice with one weapon and once with the other.

description.value:
A pair of multi-jointed arms designed for rapid weapon deployment and enhanced combat capability.

Special: Dual Strike (1 PP) - When making a full attack with two different weapons mounted on your arms, you attack twice with one weapon and once with the other.
